title: Landing hold
environment: CA: qualified Claude cloud builder/checker plus GitHub Actions

brief.goal: A landing hold the CI gate reads, set by a workflow, failing closed, with its guide.
checks: a script test for the hold reader: on, off, unreadable
a dry run of the workflow on a branch
brief.notes: Risky (CI). The hold's schedule is private and never appears in the repository.

title: The scene link
environment: CA: qualified Claude cloud builder/checker plus GitHub Actions

brief.goal: A folder can be an OBS scene; its link builds only that scene's graphics, settled; the OBS scenes switch.
checks: Node tests for scene payload filtering and unknown ids
the playout journey extended for a two-scene production
the existing output and publish journeys unchanged
brief.notes: Risky (payload, output, recovery). Follow the spec's contract with the live-publishing run. Leave a placeholder production and the OS2 checklist with its receipt template in evidence/phase-OS1a.md.

title: Clocks
environment: CA: qualified Claude cloud builder/checker plus GitHub Actions

brief.goal: Wall-clock sponsor rotation and countdowns to an absolute ISO deadline; HH:MM unchanged.
checks: Node tests over the runtimes with a fake clock, a hidden page and another timezone
brief.notes: Risky (reload semantics). A production's graphic is its own template copy: say in the evidence that graphics made before this lands need Update.

title: JSON source
environment: CA: qualified Claude cloud builder/checker plus GitHub Actions

brief.goal: A public JSON address read by NoaCG's server on the source's own interval (floor 10 s), cached once per address, applied as one snapshot.
checks: Node tests for the reader with a fake fetch and clock, two competing pages and late answers
the feed route's guard tests extended
brief.notes: Bonus scope (D8): the first cut if the run slips. Risky (api, polling). No new Vercel function. Any migration only in a quiet window and never while the landing hold is on.

title: Bracket adapter and current match
environment: CA: qualified Claude cloud builder/checker plus GitHub Actions

brief.goal: The pure bracket adapter with a field mapping set on the source, the output shape in the spec, and the operator-owned current match.
checks: Node tests with synthetic fixtures for both row shapes, duplicates and missing rows
the current match held across reads
brief.notes: Risky (state rules). Fixtures are synthetic. The checker alone reads the owner's private sample (the run notes name it) and records only pass or fail.

title: First laptop test
environment: OW: the owner's Windows laptop with the newest OBS Studio

brief.goal: The owner measures load, the stale frame and dock sign-in in OBS, with OS1a's checklist.
brief.notes: Owner phase. The hand-over carries OS1a's checklist and receipt template; he may run it as soon as OS1a lands. His receipt lands as evidence/phase-OS2.md (Ordinary). A failed line goes to the owner with the run notes' fallback before OS1b starts.

title: Take, Out and copies per scene
environment: CA: qualified Claude cloud builder/checker plus GitHub Actions

brief.goal: Take and Out per scene graphic, pool copies per scene, All out leaving scene graphics as they were.
checks: Node tests for copies, names and All out
the playout journey for Take and Out in one scene only

title: Monitoring, settings and the settled export
acceptance: AC-12's settled export and guide, as written in docs/work-specs/obs-scenes/spec.md
environment: CA: qualified Claude cloud builder/checker plus GitHub Actions

brief.goal: Scene rows, the walk-through tick, the settings section with Copy and Copy all links, the 16-output sentence and the OBS scenes guide with the fallback. The settled option on the HTML overlay export.
checks: the playout panel journey with OBS events sent by a test page
a browser test of the settled export with OBS show and hide events
brief.notes: Risky (presence state). Simulated events are not hardware proof: name the rows the owner must confirm in OS7.

title: The Live dock
environment: CA: qualified Claude cloud builder/checker plus GitHub Actions

brief.goal: A 300 px dock that signs in, runs the control session, answers Companion and holds the show's live controls.
checks: a 300 px journey for the dock
the panel relay tests for hand-over and reconnect
brief.notes: Risky (a second control session). No companion-module change unless an action is missing. Leave the OS7 checklist with its receipt template in evidence/phase-OS6.md.

title: Owner rehearsal
environment: OW: the owner's Windows laptop with the newest OBS Studio, a Stream Deck and Companion

brief.goal: The owner's full rehearsal with every failure drill, recovered alone.
brief.notes: Owner phase. The hand-over carries OS6's checklist and receipt template, including the AC-6 rows OS3 named. His receipt lands as evidence/phase-OS7.md (Ordinary).
